ComfyUI 工作流程、提示和教程的链接：在这里查看视频。

在这里查看书面教程：https://civitai.com/articles/4165

昨天，只是在玩 Stable Cascade，制作了一些电影海报来测试作文和信件写作。与此同时，我绞尽脑汁地想知道要下载哪些 HF 模型以及将 4 Stage 模型放置在哪里。

因此，我在视频中解释了它以及工作流程中 HF 的所有链接。我还使用 set/get 节点简化了意大利面条，以更好地可视化系统。

基础设置：
DPM 2M SDE 卡拉斯 -
C 阶段 25 个步骤 - 4 CFG
Stabe B 10 步 - 1 CFG
提示：史诗般的电影海报，手持钻石，在暴风雪中，脸上是一个眼睛发光的老人，底部写着一个大文字标题“HELLO”，电影霓虹灯赛博朋克灯光，

tldr 注意：没有后期制作、细节设计或升级（只是原始级联生成）。字体非常漂亮，但某些单词会不一致，具体取决于其长度。构图非常好，但正如许多人所说，质量还没有达到。我确信微调后的模型会好 10 倍！

o.en:
Link to the ComfyUI workflows, prompts and tutorials :check the video here.

Check the written tutorials here :https://civitai.com/articles/4165

Yesterday, was just playing around with Stable Cascade and made some movie poster to test the composition and letter writing. At the same time, I scratch my head to know which HF models to download and where to place the 4 Stage models.

So I explain it in the video and all the links to HF in the workflow.I've also simplified the spaghetti with set/get node to better visualize the system.

Based Settings :
DPM 2M SDE Karras -
Stage C 25 steps - 4 CFG
Stabe B 10 Steps - 1 CFG
prompt : Epic movie poster holding a diamond, in blizzard snow,with face of an old man with glowing eyes,in the bottom a big text title "HELLO" written on it,cinematic neon cyberpunk lighting,

tldr note : there were no post-production, detailer or upscaling (just the raw cascade gen).The lettering is pretty nice but will be inconsistent for some words and depending its the length.The composition is quite good but as many have said, the quality isn't there yet. I'm sure that the finetuned models will be 10x better !
